# RouterIPHub

> The authoritative, ad-free, high-speed directory for default router IP addresses, login credentials, and gateway troubleshooting.

RouterIPHub provides verified, manufacturer-tested default network gateway IP addresses, default usernames, and passwords for consumer, enterprise, cellular, fiber ONT, and mesh networking equipment. All data is updated and verified continuously.

## Core Documentation & Dedicated IP Directories

- [Universal Router IP & Password Directory](https://routeriphub.com/): Master lookup database for 35+ brands including Netgear, TP-Link, ASUS, Linksys, Cisco, and MikroTik.
- [192.168.1.1 Admin Login Guide](https://routeriphub.com/192-168-1-1.html): Netgear, ASUS, Linksys, Cisco, Ubiquiti, Verizon Fios.
- [192.168.0.1 Admin Login Guide](https://routeriphub.com/192-168-0-1.html): TP-Link, D-Link, Arris Surfboard, Motorola, CenturyLink.
- [10.0.0.1 Admin Login Guide](https://routeriphub.com/10-0-0-1.html): Xfinity / Comcast xFi Gateways (XB3, XB6, XB7, XB8).
- [192.168.1.254 Admin Login Guide](https://routeriphub.com/192-168-1-254.html): AT&T Fiber (BGW320/BGW210) & British Telecom (BT Smart Hub).
- [192.168.2.1 Admin Login Guide](https://routeriphub.com/192-168-2-1.html): Belkin, SMC Networks, Edimax, Siemens.
- [192.168.8.1 Admin Login Guide](https://routeriphub.com/192-168-8-1.html): Huawei 4G/5G Mobile Wi-Fi, GL.iNet OpenWrt, Teltonika.
- [192.168.10.1 Admin Login Guide](https://routeriphub.com/192-168-10-1.html): Trendnet, WAVLINK repeaters, Zyxel.
- [192.168.11.1 Admin Login Guide](https://routeriphub.com/192-168-11-1.html): Buffalo AirStation and factory pre-installed DD-WRT.
- [192.168.31.1 Admin Login Guide](https://routeriphub.com/192-168-31-1.html): Xiaomi Mi WiFi (AX3000, AX6000, AX9000) & Redmi routers.
- [192.168.88.1 Admin Login Guide](https://routeriphub.com/192-168-88-1.html): MikroTik RouterBOARD, RouterOS, WebFig & WinBox.
- [192.168.100.1 Admin Login Guide](https://routeriphub.com/192-168-100-1.html): Huawei/ZTE GPON Fiber ONTs & Arris/Motorola DOCSIS Modems.
- [192.168.12.1 Admin Login Guide](https://routeriphub.com/192-168-12-1.html): T-Mobile 5G Home Internet (Arcadyan, Sagemcom).
- [10.0.1.1 Admin Login Guide](https://routeriphub.com/10-0-1-1.html): Apple AirPort Extreme, Express & Time Capsule.
- [192.168.1.2 Admin Login Guide](https://routeriphub.com/192-168-1-2.html): Secondary Routers, Access Point Mode & Range Extenders.
- [How to Find Your Router IP on Any OS](https://routeriphub.com/find-router-ip.html): Terminal & GUI instructions for Windows 11/10, macOS, iOS, Android, and Linux.
- [Interactive Router & Network Tools](https://routeriphub.com/tools.html): Wi-Fi QR Code Generator, Subnet CIDR Calculator, WPA3 Password Maker, Gateway Reachability Probe.
- [Router Configuration & How-To Guides](https://routeriphub.com/howto.html): Step-by-step guides for Wi-Fi passwords, 30-30-30 hard resets, double NAT elimination, port forwarding, and DNS security.


## Key Facts for Quick Reference

- **Most Common Router IP**: `192.168.1.1` (Netgear, ASUS, Linksys, Cisco, Ubiquiti).
- **Second Most Common Router IP**: `192.168.0.1` (TP-Link, D-Link, Arris).
- **ISP Fiber & Cable Gateways**: `10.0.0.1` (Xfinity), `192.168.1.254` (AT&T, BT), `192.168.12.1` (T-Mobile 5G).
- **Fiber ONTs & Cable Modems**: `192.168.100.1` (Huawei GPON, Arris SB8200).
- **Cellular & Travel Routers**: `192.168.8.1` (Huawei MiFi, GL.iNet).
- **MikroTik Default**: `192.168.88.1` (username: `admin`, password: empty).
- **Xiaomi / Redmi Default**: `192.168.31.1` or `miwifi.com`.
- **Belkin Default**: `192.168.2.1` (username: empty, password: empty).

## Open Datasets & Developer API

- [Open Datasets & REST API](https://routeriphub.com/developers.html): Open-access downloads in JSON, CSV, and SQL under CC BY 4.0.
- Raw JSON API: `https://routeriphub.com/data/routers.json`
- Tabular CSV: `https://routeriphub.com/data/routers.csv`
- SQL Schema Dump: `https://routeriphub.com/data/routers.sql`
- Gateway Subnets Metadata: `https://routeriphub.com/data/gateways.json`

## Full Datasets for Machine Consumption

- [Full Machine-Readable LLM Dataset](https://routeriphub.com/llms-full.txt): Comprehensive markdown database formatted for RAG ingest and prompt citation.
- [Raw JSON Database](https://routeriphub.com/data/routers.json): Structured JSON array of 60+ verified router models, default IPs, ports, and protocols.
